os_list.name: Omarchy Quatro - Arch Linux ARM (Pi 5 NVMe)
os_list.description: Next-generation Arch Linux ARM workstation for Raspberry Pi 5. Features the sway Wayland compositor (Omarchy-styled: waybar, fuzzel, mako), 16k page-size kernel, PCIe Gen 3 NVMe tuning, Argon ONE / NEO 5 active cooling daemon, 8GB ZRAM swap, Chromium + SSH preinstalled, and first-boot auto-expansion.

subitems.name: Omarchy Quatro v1.0.2 (Zstandard — works out of the box)
subitems.description: Boots straight to a sway desktop with autologin. v1.0.2 fixes first boot end-to-end: correct PARTUUIDs, working auto-resize, wayland-native SDDM autologin, complete desktop packages.
